repair_configuration.protected_anchor_rule: Evaluate exact saved control components with their original parameters; keep their fixed saved blend eligible through confirmation/refit. Do not pass protected components through broad/selector mutations. Preserve candidate/control labels outside ML recipe schema, not as unsupported params.

2 One explicit broad+CatBoost selector exploratory variant per task; feature_selection_protect_original=true. Keep unchanged anchor in parallel candidate set. Protect_original only guards raw spec.features; it does not protect all learned TE/history columns, so it is insufficient to make this variant equivalent to the strong anchor.

3 Compare successful LightGBM, CatBoost and XGBoost recipes under existing identical immutable cuts. Fixed historical control components are mandatory, not droppable when top3 exploratory ranking changes.
